description: "A Voyage to South America, with an Account of a Shipwreck in the River La Plata" by George Fracker is a historical account written in the early 19th century. The narrative recounts the harrowing experiences of the sole survivor of a shipwreck, detailing both the ship's journey and the subsequent trials faced after the disaster.
